method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (fhog-core.l4, with seven regulative rules for the applicants' notice-and-repay duties, the application period and the Chief Commissioner's s 45 powers) and a seat layer (fhog-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (commencement before 1 October 2012, replacement contracts, pre-1 July 2017 caps, an unknown s 13A(4) cap and the corresponding law of another State answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: First Home Owner Grant and Shared Equity Act 2000 No 21 (NSW), act-2000-021, corpus version_id nsw_legislation:2023-09-04/act-2000-021, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2000-021.txt, taken from the Open Australian Legal Corpus version 7.1.0 (NSW Legislation collected 10 March 2025). Not the current official text and may be out of date. No regulation deposited: the s 13A(4) cap is an input defaulting to the s 13A(2) figures.

scope: From the seat of the applicant for the first home owner grant: ss 4A, 5, 6 (new home, relevant interest, spouse); s 7 (entitlement, with s 7(3) and (4)); ss 8, 8A, 9, 10, 11, 12 (the eligibility criteria and the joint-applicant exemptions); ss 13, 13AA, 13A, 13B (eligible transaction, type of grant, cap, total value); s 14(5), (6) (application period); s 15 (interested persons, s 15(2)(e) small interest holders); s 18 (amount); s 20(2), (2A), (3), (4) and s 21(2)-(4) (conditions of an advance payment, joint liability); s 45(1)-(3) (repayment and penalty). Not covered: commencement before 1 October 2012 and contracts replacing pre-1 July 2017 contracts (Schedule 1), the cap before 1 July 2017, an unknown s 13A(4) regulation cap, the corresponding law of another State or a Territory. Out: Part 2A (shared equity), s 43A (ADF grant), Parts 2B and 3, ss 6A-6D and 13(6), ss 14(1)-(4), 16, 19, 22-24, 44, 46, 46A, Schedule 1. Read with the Duties Act 1997 (NSW) (First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme; s 74(5) borrows s 4A), and, unverified, ITAA 1997 and the Social Security Act 1991 (Cth); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
